model.description: searchUsers(query): owner-gated user search for the FeatureManager grant c2-completion. Matches query across userProfiles (name/phone/token) + alt-identity units (scenario/alt/phone|email|company) -> resolves the token -> returns [{token, name, avatar?, uuid?, identifiers[]}] with MASKED identifiers, RANKED exact->prefix->substring, capped-10 flag-if-truncated. Sibling to grantFeature/revokeFeature/bootstrapSeed (listFeatures RETIRED/superseded). Owner-gated at the GET /api/feature-manager/users wrapper (requireOwnerHttp, INV-F4). mask/rank = private helpers. LOAD-BEARING marked decl (expert marks, #126). Architect topology 8916e33a5.
